description.nl: Tagliatelle in een romige saus van walnoten, knoflook en crème fraîche met een vleugje nootmuskaat.
description.en: Tagliatelle in a creamy sauce of walnuts, garlic and crème fraîche with a hint of nutmeg.

steps.en: Fry the garlic in oil in a pan until light brown. Add the nuts, the breadcrumbs, 100 ml water, some salt and pepper and the nutmeg. Stir in the crème fraîche. Let everything heat right through without boiling.
Meanwhile cook the tagliatelle al dente. Pour the sauce over the tagliatelle. Toss everything together and serve hot.

description.nl: Klassieke carbonara met krokant spek, room, ei en geraspte kaas door warme tagliatelle.
description.en: Classic carbonara with crisp bacon, cream, egg and grated cheese tossed through warm tagliatelle.

steps.en: Fry the bacon in butter until crisp. Briefly fry the garlic with it at the end. Pour off the bacon fat, keeping 1 tbsp, and remove the garlic.
Drain the bacon on kitchen paper and break it into small pieces. Pour the cream into the remaining bacon fat.
Beat the egg and the yolk together and add half of the grated cheese.
Cook the pasta al dente in water with a little salt. Drain the pasta.
Stir the cream with the egg mixture, the rest of the cheese and the parsley through the warm pasta. Add salt and pepper if needed.

name.en: Tagliatelle with beef and olive meatballs

description.nl: Kleine gehaktballetjes met groene olijven, gestoofd in tomatensaus met kwark, geserveerd op tagliatelle.
description.en: Small meatballs with green olives, simmered in a tomato sauce with quark, served on tagliatelle.

steps.en: Mix the mince, the onion, the olives, the egg, the breadcrumbs and the mince seasoning together well. Roll into 24 small meatballs.

Heat the butter in a casserole and brown the meatballs all over. Then pour in the tomato sauce, bring the sauce to the boil and let the meatballs simmer gently for about 15 minutes until cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the tagliatelle al dente in plenty of boiling salted water. Drain the tagliatelle well.
Stir the quark into the tomato sauce and season the sauce with salt and pepper.

lines.raw: 100 g groene olijven zonder pit [kleine stukjes]

name.en: Tagliatelle with turkey breast and apple sauce

description.nl: Kip of kalkoen met kerrie, gestoofd in witte wijn en bouillon met zoetzure appel, bij tagliatelle met slagroom.
description.en: Chicken or turkey with curry powder, stewed in white wine and stock with sweet-and-sour apple, served with creamy tagliatelle.

steps.en: Mix the flour, ½ tsp salt, pepper and curry powder together and toss the meat in it.
Brown the meat in butter and fry the onion with it for 3 minutes. Pour in the wine and the stock and bring to the boil.
Stir the apple into the meat and let it all stew gently.
Meanwhile cook the tagliatelle al dente in plenty of salted water. Drain the tagliatelle well in a colander. Stir the cream through the pasta.

name.en: Tagliatelle with strips of roast beef

description.nl: Snel gebakken reepjes rosbief in een tomatensaus met paprikapoeder, crème fraîche en verse kruiden, op tagliatelle.
description.en: Quickly seared strips of roast beef in a tomato sauce with paprika, crème fraîche and fresh herbs, on tagliatelle.

steps.en: Sprinkle the roast beef with pepper. Heat the butter in a casserole and quickly brown the strips of beef all over, in batches. Take the meat out of the pan and set it aside.

Gently fry the shallot and the celery in the remaining fat for about 5 minutes, then stir in the flour and the paprika. Stirring all the time, pour in the passata a splash at a time. Bring the sauce to the boil and let it simmer gently for about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile cook the pasta al dente. Stir the crème fraîche and the finely chopped herbs into the tomato sauce and season it with salt and pepper. Stir in the strips of beef with their juices and let the meat warm through over a low heat.
Drain the pasta well. Serve with the sauce and the grated cheese.

description.nl: Snelle pasta met gerookte zalm in een saus van groene pesto en crème fraîche.
description.en: Quick pasta with smoked salmon in a green pesto and crème fraîche sauce.

steps.en:
Cook the tagliatelle.
Warm the pesto and the crème fraîche in a pan. Toss the salmon together with the tagliatelle through the pesto mixture.

name.en: Tomato salsa (for cod with nut crumble)

description.nl: Frisse salsa van snacktomaten en rode ui, als bijgerecht bij kabeljauw met notencrumble.
description.en: Fresh salsa of cherry tomatoes and red onion, a side for cod with nut crumble.

steps.en: Put the tomatoes and onion in a bowl and season with salt and pepper.

description.nl: Ovenschotel van nieuwe krieltjes, tonijn, tomaat en lente-ui onder een saus van witte wijn, crème fraîche en dille.
description.en: Bake of new potatoes, tuna, tomato and spring onion under a white wine, crème fraîche and dill sauce.

steps.en: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes until almost tender, then drain well. Drain the tuna in a sieve and break it into small pieces.

Grease an ovenproof dish with a little butter. Mix the potatoes, the tomato, the spring onions and the tuna together and spoon into the dish. Stir the wine, the crème fraîche and the dill together. Pour the sauce over the potato mixture and sprinkle the grated cheese over it.
Bake at 175 °C for 20 minutes.

lines.raw: 1 vleestomaat [in stukjes; zonder vel, vocht en zaadjes]

prep.en: skinned, deseeded and cut into small pieces

description.nl: Tortellini in lagen met gebakken champignons en tomatensaus met crème fraîche, gegratineerd met Parmezaanse kaas. Vegetarisch met kaastortellini.
description.en: Tortellini layered with fried mushrooms and a tomato and crème fraîche sauce, baked with a Parmesan crust. Vegetarian with cheese tortellini.

steps.en: Cook the tortellini for 16 minutes until al dente.
Fry the mushrooms in a frying pan in half of the butter until brown. Season with salt and pepper and add the lemon juice.

In another pan, warm the tomato sauce with the crème fraîche. Grease an ovenproof dish and put half of the well-drained tortellini in it. Spread half of the mushrooms over it and top with half of the tomato sauce. Repeat. Sprinkle the Parmesan over it and dot with knobs of butter.
Bake the dish au gratin in a hot oven at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
